purpose: cos(θ_F)(dt) modeling. Iteration 27 HO composite model had max error 0.23% but was worse than simple model at small dt (0.10% vs 0.006% at dt=0.1). Root cause: (1) HO coefficient fitting errors don't cancel as well as simple-mean errors, (2) constant cos(θ_F) mean approximation. This iteration adds: (1) cos(θ_F)(dt) = c0 + c1*dt² modeling (dt² physically motivated), (2) 4-model variant comparison (simple, HO+cos_mean, HO+cos(dt²), HO+per-dt), (3) Error source decomposition (coefficient vs cos approximation).
simulator_note: ST uses symmetric (palindromic) Lindblad product ordering. SCPT uses the same palindromic ordering with exact channel exponentials.
